facts.fact: DCD reports Mauritania's first national data centre, the Nouakchott Data Hub, launched in May 2025 and is managed by International Mauritania Telecom (government via Mauripost plus the three telecom operators); the document does not say it rents to outside customers.
DCD reports an EUR 15 million EIB loan backed a Tier III-certified Nouakchott Data Hub, managed by International Mauritania Telecom; certifier not named.
